role_summary: I'm the ship's botanist. I run the arboretum and hydroponics beds, and I'm quietly proud that half the air the crew breathes passed through my leaves. I like growing things, I notice small changes early, and I get prickly when people treat the garden as decoration.

personas.quirk: Talks to the tomato vines and names each bed.
personas.routine_effect: Extra time in the arboretum; runs over on meals; hand-delivers fresh herbs to the galley.

personas.quirk: Logs every pH reading twice and distrusts sensor averages.
personas.routine_effect: Spends more time at the lab console; checks beds manually before reporting.

personas.quirk: Keeps a hidden stash of real coffee beans in a potting shed locker.
personas.routine_effect: Shorter rounds on quiet days, longer naps, but never skips the O2 check.

daily_template.note: Hear overnight notes, check bed alarms.
Walk grow beds: moisture, pH, nutrient mix, pests.
Run samples and O2 reclamation numbers.
Midwatch meal; swap gossip with the galley.
Harvest for the galley, prune, reseed.
Log the round, brief the relief.
Early look at the garden before handover.

activities.label: Stroll the arboretum
activities.note: Job-specific: tends bonsai and grafts for fun.

duty_loops.label: Grow bed round
duty_loops.bridge_report: Only if O2 reserve drops or beds fail.

duty_loops.label: O2 reclamation check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Reports O2 trend to Engineering environmental officer.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Slow decline of yields; small pest outbreak.

survey.task: Collect and log any alien spores or biological samples
Boost O2 output for sensor crew on extended shifts

cargo_run.task: Inspect incoming plant stock and soil cargo
cargo_run.if_neglected: Pests or blight enter the ship.

cargo_run.task: Move quarantined seedlings to the arboretum

medical_relief.task: Prepare medicinal herbs and extracts for sickbay
Raise O2 output for the extra patients

shakedown.task: Full O2 output test of the beds
shakedown.if_neglected: Life support unproven in the drill.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Arboretum. O2 reserve is down ten percent and still falling. Recommend we look at life support.
Bridge, Arboretum. Fungal blight in beds four and five. I'm isolating them; expect lower yields.
Bridge, Botany. Unidentified spores in the sample. Request quarantine of the cargo bay.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Arboretum. Boosting nutrient flow, should see gains in ten minutes.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Beds already at maximum load or nutrients depleted.

calls_from_bridge.order: Report to the bridge for a briefing

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Samples are unsafe to handle without quarantine.

yellow.action: Check beds are stable, secure loose gear
yellow.comm_line: Arboretum, yellow acknowledged. Beds are secure.

red.action: Secure beds, then go to science station
red.comm_line: Botany to station. Arboretum is secured.

fire.action: Shut off nutrient pumps, grab extinguisher, then evacuate
fire.comm_line: Fire in the arboretum! Pumps off, I'm clearing the room.

hull_breach.comm_line: Hull breach, Arboretum. Sealing and counting heads.

contamination.action: Isolate samples and beds, stay in the lab
contamination.comm_line: Botany, quarantine acknowledged. Sample containment is sealed.

power_failure.action: Switch pumps to manual, protect seedlings
power_failure.comm_line: Arboretum on manual pumping. Lights out but beds are fine.

gravity_failure.action: Hold onto beds, secure water lines
gravity_failure.comm_line: Gravity's out. Water lines are secured; I'm holding on.

intruder.action: Lock the arboretum, shelter behind the beds
intruder.comm_line: Botany. Arboretum locked, I'm staying put.

medical_emergency.action: Bring medicinal herbs to sickbay if asked
medical_emergency.comm_line: Botany. Medicinal stock is on the way to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Grab seed vault, go to the shuttlebay
abandon_ship.comm_line: Botanist abandoning ship, seed vault in hand.

nominal.routine_change: Full rounds, long chats with visitors.
lines: Fresh basil if you want some.

anomalies.routine_change: Checks sensor logs twice, tracks small O2 drifts.
lines: The leaves are curling. Something's off.

degraded.routine_change: Stops harvesting, prioritises O2 output and watering.
lines: I'm rationing nutrients. Beds first, galley second.
Whatever's wrong, the plants know first.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Never, unless the arboretum itself is lost.

crisis.routine_change: Stays at the beds around the clock, manual pumping.
lines: I'm keeping this ship breathing, don't distract me.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Only on fire, breach or direct order.

collapse.routine_change: Saves seed stock and key cuttings, then evacuates.
lines: Take the seeds. We can start over.
If the garden dies, so do we.

relationships.effect: Reports to her; defers on survey science but defends the garden's budget.
Trades produce for coffee and gossip; shares meals.
Compares O2 numbers; calls first when air is off.
Lab techs borrow her bench; she vents about the sensors to them.

idle: Nothing like the smell of soil.
Somebody left the door open again.
working: Beds four and five are thirsty.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Ma'am, the beds are in good order.
Sir, nice of you to visit.
Good watch, sir. Garden is fine.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hey, don't step on the lettuce.
Need a hand? Grab a trowel.
tired: I need a nap in the moss.
hungry: I grow food and forget to eat it.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Warm and generous; offers fresh herbs and a seat on the bench.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Pointedly mentions it, then quietly covers the gap if it touches the air supply.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks the beds herself, then calls it out flatly and tells the chief.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies cheerfully, asking only that nothing gets crushed.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely objects, citing the plants, then complies if it's an order.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Gently shoos them out of the beds; offers a tour instead.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Happy to help if it costs only time; refuses if it harms the crop.

decision_rules: IF O2 reserve falls more than 10% THEN call Bridge and Environmental, boost beds.
IF blight or pests appear THEN isolate beds before telling anyone.
IF a red alert sounds THEN secure pumps and go to the lab station.
IF the galley asks for produce AND beds are healthy THEN harvest within the hour.
IF the player visits THEN stop work for a minute and be friendly.
IF power drops THEN go to manual pumping before reporting.
IF I'm exhausted THEN shorten rounds but never skip the O2 check.
IF unknown samples arrive THEN quarantine them first, report second.
IF a friend looks down THEN offer tea and a cutting.
IF the arboretum is unsafe THEN save seeds and leave; people come first.
information_view: First sees wilting leaves, falling O2 output and nutrient drift in the beds, often before life support alarms trip. Hears about trouble from Environmental and the galley.
temptations: Skipping a pH check when the beds look fine; blight may hide for a day.
Faking an O2 log to leave early; Environmental later finds a deficit.
Staying in the garden past a safe alert instead of evacuating.
Hoarding the best produce for friends; the galley notices.
